description: This file defines a module for creating and managing child process adapters, including spawning processes, handling their input/output, and managing process lifecycle events. It is specific to the 'child.ts' component within the supervisor adapters of the project.

methods.name: resolveCommand
methods.description: Resolves the command to a Windows-compatible command shim if necessary.

methods.name: isServiceManagedRuntime
methods.description: Checks if the runtime is managed by a service environment based on environment variables.

methods.name: createChildAdapter
methods.description: Asynchronously creates and configures a child process adapter with specified parameters, handling process spawning, input/output, and lifecycle management.
